finalMessage:
`slugify("Crème brûlée")` now returns `"creme-brulee"`, and both tests pass.

The cause was that the regex `[^a-z0-9]` treated every accented letter as a separator. The fix is in `src/index.js`: the input is now normalized with NFKD and the combining accent marks are stripped before lowercasing and replacing non-alphanumerics. So `è` becomes `e` and `û` becomes `u`, while plain ASCII input behaves as before.

I also added the `Crème brûlée` case to the `slugify` test in `test/index.test.js`. I did not commit anything.
